creative_brief.emotional_promise: A tiny stone guardian turns one careful nudge into a surprising, self-arresting dive.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A compact two-sided card keeps setup and the dramatic action visually separate while remaining easy to store with the single-piece toy.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-page landscape 5 × 7 inch double-sided owner card.
teaching_arc: Meet the gargoyle and identify the tail hook.
Check the table edge and clear the landing area.
Place, nudge, watch the catch, and reset.
Understand the untested physical limits and stop conditions.
typography: Vera for instructions and safety copy
creative_brief.visual_motif: Stone-block panels, arched labels, and burnt-orange motion cues echo a carved rooftop guardian.

findings: The first review showed overlapping action panels that hid reset instructions and competed with the safety warning.
The cover hierarchy and exact product view were strong, though small diagram labels needed clear surrounding copy.
The grayscale proof retained usable contrast, but page two required a cleaner reading order.
resolved_changes: Rebuilt page two as a two-by-two action grid so every action and reset step remains visible.
Separated the stop warning into a full-width safety band below the numbered sequence.
Reduced and repositioned the exact product image to preserve an uncluttered reading path in color and grayscale.
